headline: The federal government said on Wednesday that Islamabad's One Constitution Avenue residential building will be turned into a five-star hotel after a JIT found the project was built on irregularities and rigging, Dawn reports.

card.desc: JIT report ke baad elaan, kharidaron ko asal raqam wapas milegi.

caption:
Islamabad ki One Constitution Avenue ab 5-star hotel banegi!
Dawn ke mutabiq federal hukumat ne Wednesday ko bataya ke JIT ke mutabiq yeh project "irregularities aur rigging" par bana tha, aur ab is building ko 5-star hotel mein badla jayega. Hukumat ke mutabiq kharidaron ko unki asal raqam wapas di jayegi.
Aap ke khayal mein yeh faisla sahi hai? Comment mein batayein 👇
